comparison_protocol.counterevidence: Record contradictions to a specific saved proposition or newly invalidated period/scope with exact evidence; do not label the company investment thesis invalid when none exists.
comparison_protocol.prior_observation_boundary: These are saved research observations, not author forecasts, financial pillars, adopted valuation inputs or future outcome predictions.
comparison_protocol.supports: Use explicit new source passages to support a specific saved definition or relationship, with same entity/period or an explicit bridge.
comparison_protocol.unchanged: A reviewed source can add no change to the tracked definitions; retain prior observations.
comparison_protocol.unresolved: Keep missing or ambiguous entity/period/accounting attribution unresolved without inventing values.

legacy_draft_boundary: Existing draft remains research-only; no registration, sending readiness or reply is implied. New native issue tracks the combined cost/tax evidence without changing old records.
purpose: Track new official disclosures against the already reviewed cost/cashflow and tax-basis distinctions; do not infer normal earnings or future tax/NOL from historic labels.
